text: {"name":"rf_configure_channel_mode","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Configures a radio channel context and related MMIO bandwidth/mode registers for the selected operating mode.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v1":"chan_ctxt","v2":"mode_table_offset","v3":"bandwidth_code","v4":"mode_mask","v5":"freq_code","v6":"rf_reg_base"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"channel/frequency code field"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"channel mode or bandwidth context field set to 3"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"context validity or enable flag"},{"offset":76,"meaning":"RF status/context enable word accessed via v8"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"RF register word set to 2048/4096 bandwidth code"},{"offset":843,"meaning":"per-mode gain or calibration byte set to 0xEC"}]}
